recipe.name: Patatas Bravas with Garlic Aioli
directions: Set up your grill for direct grilling and heat to medium-high.
Toss the potatoes with the olive oil and paprika, then season generously with salt and pepper.

Tear off a 12- by 20-inch piece of Reynolds Wrap® Non-Stick Foil. Place it dull side up (non-stick side) on your workspace. Arrange the potatoes in the center in a single layer. Bring the long edges of the foil together. Fold twice. Next, fold the short edges twice to completely enclose the potatoes. Using a fork or bamboo skewer, poke several holes in the packet to let steam escape.
Arrange the packet on the grill grate and grill, turning occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, 20 to 25 minutes.

In the meantime, make the garlic aioli: Combine the mayonnaise, garlic, and lemon juice; whisk. Season to taste with salt and pepper, adding more garlic, lemon juice, or salt and pepper. If the sauce is too thick to drizzle, add a teaspoon or two of cold water. Drizzle in a zig-zag pattern over the potatoes, or serve the aioli on the side.
